title: The Bird That Cleans Rhinos for Ticks May Be Drinking Their Blood
subject: oxpecker bird

scenes.text: The bird that cleans rhinos might be eating them.
Oxpeckers ride rhinos and buffalo, pecking ticks. For decades, that was the perfect partnership.
But many of those ticks had already fed, and one study found no clear drop in ticks on hosts with oxpeckers.
Oxpeckers have even been seen pecking wounds open to keep them raw, and drinking the blood.
Yet in a Kenyan study, black rhinos with oxpeckers noticed approaching humans at nearly twice the distance.
So are they cleaners, bodyguards, or vampires? Maybe all three.

description:
Oxpeckers were long seen as the rhino's tick cleaners, but the evidence is messier than that.
They eat ticks, but they also peck wounds open and drink blood, while their alarm calls may warn rhinos about danger.
Cleaner, bodyguard or vampire: what would you call them?
